notes.title: 🧬 BIG LANGUAGE AND TECHNICAL UPDATE 🔧
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504526/902ab2043e1945987a0739b599cdbb1e126cad2c.gif

This update is more than just fixes!
It's opening up to players from all over the world!

🌍 Added full support for 12 languages:
Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, German, Polish, Ukrainian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Italian

🔧 Optimization - the game runs smoother than ever.
🧱 Collisions - collision detection and environmental physics have been improved, eliminating known character-blocking bugs.
🕹️ Redesigned controls - for maximum responsiveness and fluidity. Every action of the player translates into an immediate and precise response of the character.
